note: forkPointSha = merge-base of our main and careerops/main, the last upstream commit our tree carries wholesale (v1.39.0 + 1). lastReviewedSha = the last upstream commit reviewed; advance it with .claude/skills/upstream-review/scripts/upstream-review.sh --advance <tip-sha>. Sync is merge-first (see the skill): after a merge the merge-base moves to the upstream tip and lastReviewedSha is an ancestor of HEAD; after a cherry-pick it is not. The driver's range is always lastReviewedSha..careerops/main and it computes the merge-base itself.
